notes.title: Wilmot's Patch Notes V1.027
notes.content:
Wilmot and the team have added four new languages to the game! They've also fixed some bits & bobs. 

[list]
[*] Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese localization added.
[*] Added an option to enlarge UI text.
[*] Added the ability to disable the flashing piece placement hint.
[*] Added a high contrast color mode toggle.
[*] Added a neutral background toggle.
[*] Corrected the localization in some languages of puzzle titles intended to be in French.
[*] Addressed an instance where ghostly door knocks could occur.
[*] Cleaned up some instances of movement and puzzle piece rotation which could cause a puzzle piece to become stuck inside another puzzle piece.
[/list]

notes.title: Wilmot's Patch Notes V1.016
notes.content:
Wilmot and the team have been hard at work at fixing stuff! Here's the details: 
[list]
[*] Fixed umlauts not rendering above "o" characters.
[*] Addressed swapped keys on QWERTZ keyboards.
[*] The game will now ignore mouse cursor position when playing with a controller.
[*] Fixed prompt appearing if previous season's puzzles were removed from wall before unpacking the initial delivery of the next season.
[*] Fixed music accidentally swapping between tracks in marathon mode.
[*] Implemented limit on amount of pieces that can be pushed at the same time.
[*] The game will no longer duplicate puzzles when attempting to place them overlapping the front door.
[/list]

notes.title: Wilmot's Patch Notes V1.007
notes.content:
Wilmot & the team have been fixing stuff! Here's the details. 

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where frame customization menu would instantly close when opening
[*] Removed menu cursor navigating clicking sfx when the game is minimized
[*] Fixed issue where tooltip icons can maintain the colour scheme of a previous wall when switching rooms
[*] Fixed room selection screen being cut off in some resolutions
[*] If you back out of wall view while targeting rightmost rooms, re-entering wall view will have a rightward swing animation.
[*] Fixed issue where chosen colour scheme in a room can mismatch the color palette of puzzle frames and accessories
[*] Fixed issue where accessories render in front of Wilmot and other foreground objects in certain rooms
[*] Fixed issue where season end music wasn't affected by music volume in options
[*] Fixed sideways movements causing Wilmot to judder when controlled with gamepad
[*] Hallway wallpaper is the correct height now so Wilmot no longer wallpapers his skirting boards.
[/list]

Localization and credit updates.

- Fixed issue where tooltip icons can maintain the colour scheme of a previous wall when switching rooms

- If you back out of wall view while targeting rightmost rooms, re-entering wall view will have a rightward swing animation.
- Fixed issue where chosen colour scheme in a room can mismatch the color palette of puzzle frames and accessories
- Fixed issue where accessories render in front of Wilmot and other foreground objects in certain rooms
- Fixed issue where season end music wasn't affected by music volume in options
- Fixed sideways movements causing Wilmot to judder when controlled with gamepad
- Hallway wallpaper is the correct height now so Wilmot no longer wallpapers his skirting boards.

notes.title: Wilmot Works It Out Feature Reveal 3
notes.content:
Wilmot can be found putting together puzzles [b]on his own[/b] in the demo for Wilmot Works It Out. But he won't be lonely for long! You'll be able to unlock a little companion for him once he gets his house a bit more in order!

The nicest thing about these pets is that they don't add any stress to the game at all! They just add a little love and coziness to his house!

Do you think Wilmot is a cat person?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157730/29737c61646f69b7a280efb27e555dc9fd6c0cf4.png[/img]

Or a dog person? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157730/519fcee00b530936147a3bb03c8ea257b142752c.png[/img]

Play the game twice and maybe he can be both! 

[h2]Wilmot Works It Out is launching on October 23rd! Wishlist it today! [/h2]

tags.feature: You'll be able to unlock a little companion for him once he gets his house a bit more in order!

notes.title: Wilmot Works It Out Feature Reveal 2
notes.content:
There are over 60 different puzzles that you'll help Wilmot put together over the course of the main game, but what can you do after you beat it? That's where Marathon Mode comes in! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157730/f96adae388c9161908169fe76de352e61da8c08d.png[/img]

You'll unlock Marathon Mode after you beat the game. Which means you can receive every single piece of every puzzle in the game in random order. You'll be able to sort, ponder, and organize to your heart's content!

[h2]Wilmot Works It Out is launching on October 23rd! Wishlist it today! [/h2]
